Outcome recorded for each (recruit, rank) milestone; only PAID moved reputation. PRE_EXISTING: the rank was already held when milestones were introduced. INELIGIBLE: the referral is ineligible, or has no eligibility record. NO_RECRUITER: the recruiter account no longer exists.
